paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between computational power, measured in TFLOPs, and loss ratio in percentage. The x-axis represents TFLOPs and has a custom scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks labeled at intervals like 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e81 3e81 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8 and 9e8. The y-axis represents the loss ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100%, marked at regular intervals of 1. Five lines are depicted in this plot. The purple line with triangle markers and a solid style represents the "Vanilla" method. It remains constant at 100% across the x-axis. The orange line with line markers represents "SepLLM (n=64)" and increases from approximately 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs, even goes above 100% at 4e8. The blue line with cross markers depicts "SepLLM (n=128)", starting at about 97% and ending at below 100%, with a steady increase. The green line with diamond markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and follows a similar pattern, beginning at approximately 97.5% and peaking more than 100 and reaching slightly below 100% towards the end. The red line with round markers shows "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starting at 94%, peaking at around 99% near 4e8 TFLOPs, and slightly declining towards 98.8% near the end of the x-axis. A legend is given bottom right.
